north.evidence: Fig. 17, Rao 1979 MASI 78 vol. I, printed page 109 (PDF page 120): compass-rose disc with an arrow through its centre, half arrowhead pointing to the upper right, at the upper right of the plan. No letter N and no legend or text stating true or magnetic north on the figure.
